description: Sunshine records: long-term mean sunshine hours per month at weather stations, which weight the sun's positions by how likely the sun is to be out (BRE BR 209's probable sunlight hours: 'allowing for average levels of cloudiness for the location in question, based on sunshine probability data'). A station answers inside its `coverage.bbox` [w,s,e,n] in WGS84; a place no station covers gets no sunlight-to-windows reading. `monthHours` runs January to December. Read by js/planning/effects-advisor.js; the calculation is NeighbourEffects.sunYear.

stations.name: Heathrow (London Airport)
stations.derivation: Mean of the station's monthly sunshine totals for 1991-2020: 30 years for each month, none estimated or missing.
